The '''Pirate Master's quarters''' were the personal dwelling-space of [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]] aboard [[Crimson Jack's battlecruiser]]. They included luxurious, comfortable furniture. Jack used the quarters to relax, partake of meals, and entertain guests.
